description: This Java source file defines an abstract superclass for custom data types within the OpenMRS platform, specifically for datatypes that extend OpenmrsObject. It provides a serialize method that returns the UUID of the object.

classes.name: BaseOpenmrsDatatype
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a superclass for custom OpenMRS data types that handle OpenmrsObject instances and serialize them by their UUID.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Returns the UUID of the provided OpenmrsObject. If the input is null, it returns null.
